## Chat
- **Choose a typeface.** Settings ▸ Chat now offers Sans, Serif or Rounded. Open chats change right away.
- **Scrolling along is up to you.** A new setting, "Scroll along with new text" (Settings ▸ Chat ▸ Appearance), lets the chat follow an answer while it is being written. It is off by default.
- **Chat knows today's date.** Answers, meeting context and titles now know the current date, time and time zone.

## Dictate Prompt
- **The card (⌘2) is shorter.** It shows your last three prompts and the text field. The prompt you used last is already selected, so ↩ runs it again.

## Meetings
- **Edit the live notes.** You can now edit, split or delete notes in the notes tab and in the chat. A late update after the meeting no longer overwrites your edit.
- **Start meetings from the menu bar.** The menu bar menu has a row to start, resume or stop meeting transcription.

## Settings
- **Settings no longer closes when you click elsewhere.** If you turned that on deliberately, switch it on again in Settings ▸ General.
- **Optional Dock icon** in Settings ▸ General.
- "Send My Settings" no longer closes the Settings window when the sheet opens.

## Dictation
- When no API key is left, WhisperShortcut switches to an offline model you have downloaded. If you have none, it offers to download one instead of asking for a key.

## Under the hood
- Mail: a slow mail server can no longer stall a mail command beyond 20 seconds.
- Release builds are about three times faster.

## Installation
Download the DMG from the [releases page](https://github.com/mgsgde/whisper-shortcut/releases), open it, and drag WhisperShortcut to your Applications folder.

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/mgsgde/whisper-shortcut/compare/v8.80...v8.81
